name: omniya-core
description: Experimental local-first prototype exploring screen-reader-first mathematical workspaces.

scripts.bana:example-corpus: npm run bana:examples && node scripts/bana-example-corpus-generate.mjs docs/bana-official-examples.json docs/bana-electron-official-corpus.json
scripts.bana:audit: npm run bana:merge-electron --silent && BANA_ELECTRON_RESULTS=docs/bana-electron-results.json npm run bana:enrich && node scripts/bana-coverage-gate.mjs docs/bana-coverage.json
scripts.bana:report: node scripts/bana-source-inventory.mjs docs/bana-source-inventory.json && node scripts/bana-example-extract.mjs docs/bana-official-examples.json && npm run bana:merge-electron --silent && BANA_ELECTRON_RESULTS=docs/bana-electron-results.json npm run bana:enrich && node scripts/bana-report.mjs docs/bana-coverage.json docs/bana-coverage-report.md && node scripts/bana-audit-table.mjs docs/bana-coverage.json docs/bana-audit-table.md && node scripts/bana-coverage-gate.mjs docs/bana-coverage.json
scripts.test:bana:all: npm run bana:report && npm run test:bana:unit && npm run test:bana:accuracy && npm run test:bana:electron

author: Axiya
